title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Upgrade Discount on Room Reservations Room-Type Moves
content:
## Elite benefit

Ashbury Rewards elite members receive an upgrade discount on the room-type differential when a Room Reservations reservation is moved to a room type that sleeps its registered adults. A guest whose attached Ashbury Rewards membership holds the Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite tier with at least 50 elite night credits in the current year receives the top elite upgrade discount of 50% on the differential; one whose membership holds the Platinum Elite or Gold Elite tier with at least 25 elite night credits receives the middle elite upgrade discount of 30%; any other guest receives no elite upgrade discount (0%).

The discount is read from the Ashbury Rewards membership attached to the reservation: its current tier and its elite night credits accrued in the current calendar year. The differential is multiplied by one less the discount.

## Benefit table

| Tier of the attached membership | Elite night credits this year | Upgrade discount on the differential |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 50 or more | 50% |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 49 or fewer | 0% |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 25 or more | 30% |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 24 or fewer | 0% |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite or Ashbury Rewards Member | any | 0% |
| No membership attached | — | 0% |

The night thresholds are each tier group's own: a Titanium Elite member with 30 elite night credits has passed the 25-night figure of the Platinum and Gold group but holds neither of those tiers, so receives no discount.

## Illustration (hypothetical differential of 170.00 per night)

| Member | Discount | Differential after the discount |
|---|---|---|
| Ambassador Elite, 50 elite night credits | 50% | 85.00 |
| Gold Elite, 25 elite night credits | 30% | 119.00 |
| Platinum Elite, 24 elite night credits | 0% | 170.00 |
